impact: A quant fund rotating from NVDA into MU and GOOGL is a mild positive signal for two holdings, but it reflects positions as of Sep 30, before the recent memory selloff.
summary: Renaissance Technologies' Q3 13F (filed Nov 12) shows its Nvidia stake fell from 7,091,256 shares to 23,170. Micron became its largest position at $1.62B, ahead of Alphabet ($1.38B) and AMD ($1.21B), and it added a new $620.5M SpaceX stake. A 13F is a quarter-end snapshot and doesn't show timing or prices of the sales.
title: Renaissance cut Nvidia 99.7% in Q3; Micron now its largest holding
